name: questions-and-forms
about: a question and an MCP form each dock the robot as they open, and each answer sends it out again

steps.prompt: /robovac Use the AskUserQuestion tool once to ask me the question "Proceed?" with the two options yes and no. Then use the Bash tool to run exactly: sleep 8 . Then reply with only the word asked.
Call the mcp__form__ask tool once. Then use the Bash tool to run exactly: sleep 8 . Then reply with only the word formed.
